_about: Hand-made corrections to the measured photo metadata (photo_analysis.py), keyed by site path. An entry with sha1 applies only to that exact file, so a replaced photo never inherits it. Fields: x0/x1 (usable horizontal range), crown, backdrop (ko | lt | null), ex/ey/em/box_h (face position), b/c (tone). After editing, the next backfill re-measures the file; static images: run python3 photo_analysis.py --static.
